displayDescription.en:
Whisper reframed speech recognition as a scale-and-diversity problem. OpenAI trained an encoder-decoder Transformer on 680,000 hours of multilingual and multitask audio gathered with weak supervision, avoiding dependence on a narrowly curated benchmark corpus.

The model performs transcription, translation, language identification and timestamp prediction through a shared token interface. Its zero-shot robustness across datasets made a practical case for broad web-scale supervision in speech systems.
displayDescription.zh:
Whisper 把语音识别重新表述为规模与数据多样性问题。OpenAI 使用 68 万小时多语种、多任务弱监督音频训练编码器-解码器 Transformer，降低了对狭窄人工整理基准语料的依赖。

模型通过统一的 token 接口完成转写、翻译、语言识别和时间戳预测。它在多个数据集上的零样本稳健性，证明了大规模网络弱监督对实用语音系统的价值。

html.en: Before Whisper, strong speech recognizers were often optimized for specific languages, domains or curated datasets. The 2022 work tested whether a much larger and more diverse weakly supervised corpus could trade benchmark specialization for broad robustness.
html.zh: Whisper 之前，强大的语音识别系统往往针对特定语言、领域或人工整理数据集优化。2022 年这项工作检验了更大、更多样的弱监督语料能否以较少的基准专门化换取更广泛的稳健性。

html.en: Whisper uses an encoder-decoder Transformer and represents transcription, translation, language identification and timestamps in one sequence-to-sequence format. Training on 680,000 hours lets one model reuse signals across languages and tasks instead of maintaining separate pipelines.
html.zh: Whisper 使用编码器-解码器 Transformer，并把转写、翻译、语言识别和时间戳统一表示为序列到序列任务。68 万小时训练数据让一个模型能够跨语言、跨任务复用信号，而不必维护彼此分离的流水线。

html.en: Experts generally treat Whisper as a turning point in open, general-purpose speech recognition because its released models made robust multilingual transcription widely accessible. Its influence also extends to speech interfaces for later multimodal and conversational systems.
html.zh: 专家通常把 Whisper 视为开放通用语音识别的重要转折点，因为公开模型让稳健的多语种转写更容易获得。它的影响还延伸到后来多模态系统和对话系统的语音入口。
